literature.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期禽流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 死亡病例(CAT 1)的病理检查显示急性坏死性支气管间质性肺炎、非化脓性脑膜脑炎和播散性肝坏死病灶。与禽类分离株不同,猫科分离株表现出与哺乳动物病毒适应相关的 PB2-E627K 突变。第二只猫 (CAT 2) 的 AIV 基因组 检测呈阴性,但针对 NPA、H5 和 N1 抗体进行了血清转化。 [10.1111/irv.70311]
确定的关键主题包括难以进入农场和接触高危人群,缺乏足够的指导方针来主动应对对人类健康产生影响的人畜共患 暴发,维持备灾计划、能力和基础设施的重要性,以及由于资源限制和联邦领导层变化而导致未来应对 暴发 能力的不确定性。 [10.2105/ajph.2026.308656]

我们表明,基于家禽设施每小时鹅分数 (gp/h) 的序数百分位排名系统可以有效预测德尔马瓦半岛的 HPAIv H5N1 暴发 风险。7 个带有 暴发 的设施处于第 78-99 个风险百分位,其中一个在 6,021 个设施中排名前 25。冬季时间(周)是暴露的关键预测因素,GSGO 在冬中后期(12 月 15 日至 2 月 28 日)出现较多,CANG 暴露在初冬(11 月 28 日至 12 月 11 日)达到峰值,然后稳定到冬末(2 月至 3 月 13 日),随后暴露再次增加。较冷的温度(低于 0°C)显着增加了 GSGO 暴露,因为他们寻找废弃谷物作为能源。 [10.1371/journal.pone.0355415]
值得注意的是,与 E02 和 E03 相比,H19 和 E01 在多种条件下表现出更长的环境持久性。 [10.1002/jmv.71127]
2025/26 年夏季,在澳大利亚南极领地沿海地区没有发现 HPAI H5N1 的证据。该病毒于 2026 年 6 月在南极半岛得到证实,但在南极洲大陆的其他地区并未得到证实。 [10.1111/irv.70310]

literature.headline_en: Recent Avian influenza A viruses literature
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Pathological examination of the fatal case (CAT 1) revealed acute necrotizing bronchointerstitial pneumonia, non-suppurative meningoencephalitis, and disseminated foci of hepatic necrosis. The feline isolate exhibited the PB2-E627K mutation associated with mammalian virus adaptation, unlike avian isolates. [10.1111/irv.70311]

Key themes identified included difficulty accessing farms and reaching at-risk populations, lack of sufficient guidelines for proactively responding to zoonotic outbreaks with human health implications, the importance of maintaining preparedness planning, capacity, and infrastructure, and uncertainty around future capacity to respond to outbreaks due to resource constraints and changes in federal leadership. [10.2105/ajph.2026.308656]

We showed that an ordinal-percentile ranking system, based on goose points per hour (gp/h) at poultry facilities, effectively predicted HPAIv H5N1 outbreak risks in the Delmarva Peninsula. Seven facilities with outbreaks were in the 78-99th risk percentile, including one ranked among the top 25 of 6,021 facilities. [10.1371/journal.pone.0355415]
Notably, H19 and E01 demonstrated prolonged environmental persistence compared with E02 and E03 under multiple conditions. [10.1002/jmv.71127]

No evidence of HPAI H5N1 was found in the coastal areas of Australia's Antarctic Territory during the 2025/26 austral summer. The virus was confirmed in the Antarctic Peninsula in June 2026, but not in other parts of continental Antarctica. [10.1111/irv.70310]

literature.zh: 本期禽流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。；死亡病例(CAT 1)的病理检查显示急性坏死性支气管间质性肺炎、非化脓性脑膜脑炎和播散性肝坏死病灶。与禽类分离株不同,猫科分离株表现出与哺乳动物病毒适应相关的 PB2-E627K 突变。第二只猫 (CAT 2) 的 AIV 基因组 检测呈阴性,但针对 NPA、H5 和 N1 抗体进行了血清转化。；确定的关键主题包括难以进入农场和接触高危人群,缺乏足够的指导方针来主动应对对人类健康产生影响的人畜共患 暴发,维持备灾计划、能力和基础设施的重要性,以及由于资源限制和联邦领导层变化而导致未来应对 暴发 能力的不确定性。；我们表明,基于家禽设施每小时鹅分数 (gp/h) 的序数百分位排名系统可以有效预测德尔马瓦半岛的 HPAIv H5N1 暴发 风险。7 个带有 暴发 的设施处于第 78-99 个风险百分位,其中一个在 6,021 个设施中排名前 25。冬季时间(周)是暴露的关键预测因素,GSGO 在冬中后期(12 月 15 日至 2 月 28 日)出现较多,CANG 暴露在初冬(11 月 28 日至 12 月 11 日)达到峰值,然后稳定到冬末(2 月至 3 月 13 日),随后暴露再次增加。较冷的温度(低于 0°C)显着增加了 GSGO 暴露,因为他们寻找废弃谷物作为能源。；值得注意的是,与 E02 和 E03 相比,H19 和 E01 在多种条件下表现出更长的环境持久性。 [10.1002/jmv.71127]。
literature.en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments. Pathological examination of the fatal case (CAT 1) revealed acute necrotizing bronchointerstitial pneumonia, non-suppurative meningoencephalitis, and disseminated foci of hepatic necrosis. Key themes identified included difficulty accessing farms and reaching at-risk populations, lack of sufficient guidelines for proactively responding to zoonotic outbreaks with human health implications, the importance of maintaining preparedness planning, capacity, and infrastructure, and uncertainty around future capacity to respond to outbreaks due to resource constraints and changes in federal leadership. We showed that an ordinal-percentile ranking system, based on goose points per hour (gp/h) at poultry facilities, effectively predicted HPAIv H5N1 outbreak risks in the Delmarva Peninsula. Notably, H19 and E01 demonstrated prolonged environmental persistence compared with E02 and E03 under multiple conditions. [10.1002/jmv.71127].

papers.title: Highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses in mammals: host-range expansion and implications of milk-borne viral shedding.
papers.abstract: SUMMARY Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) viruses, especially subtype H5N1, have caused major outbreaks in poultry and serious human infections since the first description of “fowl plague” in 1878. Over time, these viruses have expanded their host range, causing huge losses in domestic poultry, spreading among wild bird populations, and occasionally infecting humans. Understanding how influenza viruses adapt and cross species barriers depends on analyzing their fundamental molecular characteristics. Key features such as the polybasic cleavage site within the hemagglutinin protein and the distinctive “1+7” ribonucleoprotein complex, which consists of a single polymerase core surrounded by seven RNA segments, enhance viral replication and broaden host range. Despite decades of intervention, including lessons from the 1997 Hong Kong outbreak and the continued global circulation of clade 2.3.4.4b, HPAI remains difficult to control. A major shift occurred in 2024, when H5N1 was detected in U.S. This was the first confirmed instance of viral shedding into milk from a mammalian host, suggesting a new potential route of transmission beyond the traditional avian reservoirs. This review unites historical milestones, structural insights, epidemiological data, and recent cross-species findings to better define the current landscape of risk and transmission. We further discuss economic, public health, and agricultural impacts of these developments, particularly the 2024 cattle cases, and underscore the urgent need for an integrated One Health approach to better manage the growing risks posed by HPAI viruses.

papers.title: H5N1 Clade 2.3.4.4b Infections in Domestic Cats During an Avian Influenza Outbreak in Italy: Implications for One Health Surveillance.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background H5Nx goose/Guangdong (Gs/GD) lineage highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) viruses pose a significant public health threat due to their global spread, mutation accumulation, and expanding host range. The descendant clade 2.3.4.4b has been causing widespread infections in birds and increasing spillover events in mammals. Methods This report documents the first fatal case of highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b infection in a domestic cat in Italy, detected in early January 2025. The cat (CAT 1) resided on a backyard poultry farm experiencing a high pathogenicity avian influenza outbreak and succumbed rapidly following the onset of respiratory signs. A second exposed cat (CAT 2) developed clinical disease without fatal outcome. Comprehensive outbreak investigations were conducted, including pathological, serological, molecular analyses, and genomic characterization. Results Pathological examination of CAT 1 revealed acute necrotizing bronchointerstitial pneumonia, non‐suppurative meningoencephalitis, and disseminated foci of hepatic necrosis. Interestingly, the PB2‐E627K mutation associated with mammalian virus adaptation was observed in the feline viral isolate compared to avian isolates. Such polymerase complex mutations are key determinants of host range and increase pathogenicity in mammals. CAT 2 from the same farm tested negative for AIV genome detection but subsequently seroconverted for antibodies against NPA, H5, and N1. Conclusion Sharing these findings is crucial for surveillance aimed at enabling early identification of increased risks to human and animal health, preventing cross‐species viral transmission and mitigating the risk of potential spillover events.

source_records.title: H5N1 Clade 2.3.4.4b Infections in Domestic Cats During an Avian Influenza Outbreak in Italy: Implications for One Health Surveillance.
source_records.abstract: Background H5Nx goose/Guangdong (Gs/GD) lineage highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) viruses pose a significant public health threat due to their global spread, mutation accumulation, and expanding host range. The descendant clade 2.3.4.4b has been causing widespread infections in birds and increasing spillover events in mammals. Methods This report documents the first fatal case of highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b infection in a domestic cat in Italy, detected in early January 2025. The cat (CAT 1) resided on a backyard poultry farm experiencing a high pathogenicity avian influenza outbreak and succumbed rapidly following the onset of respiratory signs. A second exposed cat (CAT 2) developed clinical disease without fatal outcome. Comprehensive outbreak investigations were conducted, including pathological, serological, molecular analyses, and genomic characterization. Results Pathological examination of CAT 1 revealed acute necrotizing bronchointerstitial pneumonia, non-suppurative meningoencephalitis, and disseminated foci of hepatic necrosis. Interestingly, the PB2-E627K mutation associated with mammalian virus adaptation was observed in the feline viral isolate compared to avian isolates. Such polymerase complex mutations are key determinants of host range and increase pathogenicity in mammals. CAT 2 from the same farm tested negative for AIV genome detection but subsequently seroconverted for antibodies against NPA, H5, and N1. Conclusion Sharing these findings is crucial for surveillance aimed at enabling early identification of increased risks to human and animal health, preventing cross-species viral transmission and mitigating the risk of potential spillover events.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the potential for H5Nx avian influenza viruses to infect and cause disease in domestic cats, highlighting the public health threat posed by these viruses due to their global spread, mutation accumulation, and expanding host range.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study documented the first fatal case of H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b infection in a domestic cat in Italy, detected in early January 2025, during an avian influenza outbreak on a backyard poultry farm.
analysis.methods: The study involved comprehensive outbreak investigations, including pathological, serological, molecular analyses, and genomic characterization of the viral isolate from the infected cat.
analysis.main_results: Pathological examination of the fatal case (CAT 1) revealed acute necrotizing bronchointerstitial pneumonia, non-suppurative meningoencephalitis, and disseminated foci of hepatic necrosis. The feline isolate exhibited the PB2-E627K mutation associated with mammalian virus adaptation, unlike avian isolates. A second cat (CAT 2) tested negative for AIV genome detection but seroconverted for antibodies against NPA, H5, and N1.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b can infect domestic cats and may possess mutations that enhance its ability to adapt to mammalian hosts, suggesting a potential risk for cross-species transmission.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results emphasize the importance of monitoring avian influenza outbreaks in domestic animals to identify early signs of viral adaptation and spillover risks, which can inform One Health surveillance strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a single fatal case and one non-fatal case, which limits the generalizability of the findings. However, the presence of specific mutations in the feline isolate supports the evidence for host adaptation, indicating moderate confidence in the results.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports the first fatal case of H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b avian influenza virus infection in a domestic cat in Italy, detected during an avian influenza outbreak on a backyard poultry farm. The cat exhibited severe pathological changes, including acute necrotizing bronchointerstitial pneumonia and hepatic necrosis. The viral isolate showed the PB2-E627K mutation, typically associated with mammalian adaptation, unlike avian isolates. A second cat from the same farm tested negative for AIV genome detection but seroconverted for antibodies against NPA, H5, and N1. These findings highlight the potential for H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b to infect mammals and adapt to new hosts, underscoring the need for enhanced One Health surveillance to detect and mitigate cross-species transmission risks. The study's limited sample size and focus on a single outbreak may affect the generalizability of the results, though the observed mutations provide moderate confidence in the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查 H5Nx 禽流感 病毒感染家猫并引起疾病的可能性,强调这些病毒由于其全球传播、突变 积累和扩大 宿主 范围而对公共卫生构成威胁。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the potential for H5Nx avian influenza viruses to infect and cause disease in domestic cats, highlighting the public health threat posed by these viruses due to their global spread, mutation accumulation, and expanding host range.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study documented the first fatal case of H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b infection in a domestic cat in Italy, detected in early January 2025, during an avian influenza outbreak on a backyard poultry farm.
analysis_en.methods: The study involved comprehensive outbreak investigations, including pathological, serological, molecular analyses, and genomic characterization of the viral isolate from the infected cat.
analysis_en.main_results: Pathological examination of the fatal case (CAT 1) revealed acute necrotizing bronchointerstitial pneumonia, non-suppurative meningoencephalitis, and disseminated foci of hepatic necrosis. The feline isolate exhibited the PB2-E627K mutation associated with mammalian virus adaptation, unlike avian isolates. A second cat (CAT 2) tested negative for AIV genome detection but seroconverted for antibodies against NPA, H5, and N1.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b can infect domestic cats and may possess mutations that enhance its ability to adapt to mammalian hosts, suggesting a potential risk for cross-species transmission.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results emphasize the importance of monitoring avian influenza outbreaks in domestic animals to identify early signs of viral adaptation and spillover risks, which can inform One Health surveillance strategies.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a single fatal case and one non-fatal case, which limits the generalizability of the findings. papers.title_zh: H5N1 分支 2.3.4.4b 在意大利 禽流感 暴发 期间家猫感染:对 One Health 监测 的影响。
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background H5Nx goose/Guangdong (Gs/GD) lineage highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) viruses pose a significant public health threat due to their global spread, mutation accumulation, and expanding host range. The descendant clade 2.3.4.4b has been causing widespread infections in birds and increasing spillover events in mammals. Methods This report documents the first fatal case of highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b infection in a domestic cat in Italy, detected in early January 2025. The cat (CAT 1) resided on a backyard poultry farm experiencing a high pathogenicity avian influenza outbreak and succumbed rapidly following the onset of respiratory signs. A second exposed cat (CAT 2) developed clinical disease without fatal outcome. Comprehensive outbreak investigations were conducted, including pathological, serological, molecular analyses, and genomic characterization. Results Pathological examination of CAT 1 revealed acute necrotizing bronchointerstitial pneumonia, non‐suppurative meningoencephalitis, and disseminated foci of hepatic necrosis. Interestingly, the PB2‐E627K mutation associated with mammalian virus adaptation was observed in the feline viral isolate compared to avian isolates. Such polymerase complex mutations are key determinants of host range and increase pathogenicity in mammals. CAT 2 from the same farm tested negative for AIV genome detection but subsequently seroconverted for antibodies against NPA, H5, and N1. Conclusion Sharing these findings is crucial for surveillance aimed at enabling early identification of increased risks to human and animal health, preventing cross‐species viral transmission and mitigating the risk of potential spillover events.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 H5Nx 鹅/广东 (Gs/GD) 谱系 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 病毒由于其全球传播、突变 积累和 宿主 范围的扩大而对公共卫生构成重大威胁。后代进化枝 2.3.4.4b 已在鸟类中引起广泛感染,并增加了哺乳动物中的 跨物种溢出 事件。方法 本报告记录了 2025 年 1 月上旬在意大利发现的首例家猫感染 高致病性禽流感 病毒 (HPAIV) H5N1 分支 2.3.4.4b 的死亡病例。这只猫 (CAT 1) 居住在一个后院家禽养殖场,经历了高致病性 禽流感 暴发,并在出现呼吸道症状后迅速死亡。第二只暴露的猫(CAT 2)出现了临床疾病,但没有致命的后果。进行了全面的 暴发 研究,包括病理学、血清学、分子分析和基因组表征。结果 CAT 1 病理检查提示急性坏死性支气管间质性肺炎、非化脓性脑膜脑炎、播散性肝坏死灶。有趣的是,与禽类病毒分离株相比,在猫科病毒分离株中观察到与哺乳动物病毒适应相关的 PB2-E627K 突变。这种聚合酶复合物 突变 是 宿主 范围的关键决定因素,并增加哺乳动物的致病性。来自同一农场的 CAT 2 的 AIV 基因组 检测呈阴性,但随后发生针对 NPA、H5 和 N1 抗体的血清转化。结论 分享这些发现对于 监测 至关重要,旨在尽早识别人类和动物健康风险增加、预防跨物种病毒 传播 并减轻潜在 跨物种溢出 事件的风险。

papers.title: Development and Characterization of Candidate Vaccine Viruses Against High Pathogenicity Avian Influenza A(H5) Viruses for Rapid Pandemic Response.
papers.abstract: High pathogenicity avian influenza A(H5) viruses pose a pandemic threat. These viruses have rapidly evolved in birds and frequently crossed species barriers, resulting in over 1000 confirmed human infections, with a case fatality proportion of approximately 50%. In response, the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has developed dozens of A(H5) candidate vaccine viruses (CVVs) over the past 2 decades, primarily targeting clades known to infect humans. This report summarizes the development and characterization of the CVVs, with a particular focus on their antigenic relationships with clades 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) viruses, which have been responsible for the majority of recent human infections.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the development and characterization of candidate vaccine viruses (CVVs) against high pathogenicity avian influenza A(H5) viruses, with an emphasis on their potential for rapid pandemic response. The central question is how these CVVs can be optimized to address the threat posed by A(H5) viruses, particularly those that have caused significant human infections.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on the development and characterization of A(H5) CVVs by the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) over the past 2 decades. It primarily targets clades known to infect humans, such as 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) viruses. The evidence is derived from the CDC's work and includes detailed descriptions of the CVVs' properties and their antigenic relationships with specific viral strains.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that the CDC has developed numerous A(H5) CVVs to address the pandemic threat posed by high pathogenicity avian influenza A(H5) viruses. These CVVs are specifically designed to target clades that have been responsible for the majority of recent human infections, such as 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) viruses.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights the rapid evolution of A(H5) viruses in birds and their frequent crossing of species barriers, which has led to over 1000 confirmed human infections with a case fatality proportion of approximately 50%. However, it does not provide detailed information on the effectiveness of these CVVs in preventing or mitigating human infections, nor does it address potential controversies or limitations in their development and application.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that the development of A(H5) CVVs is a critical step in preparing for potential pandemics caused by these viruses. It emphasizes the need for continued surveillance and characterization of these viruses to ensure that the CVVs remain effective against emerging strains. Additionally, it highlights the importance of understanding the antigenic relationships between CVVs and circulating A(H5) viruses to guide vaccine design and deployment.

The review highlights the pandemic threat of A(H5) viruses, which have evolved rapidly in birds and crossed species barriers, causing over 1000 human infections with a 50% case fatality rate. The implications suggest the need for ongoing surveillance and research to ensure the CVVs remain relevant against emerging strains.

papers.title: Using high frequency GPS data to assess wintering goose proximity to commercial poultry facilities on the Delmarva peninsula for avian influenza risk management and surveillance.
papers.abstract: The ongoing global outbreak of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza Virus (HPAIv) Clade 2.3.4.4 H5N1 in poultry, which was first detected in the United States (USA) in February 2022, underscores the importance of improving food biosecurity and wild bird surveillance. The Delmarva Peninsula is vital to wintering waterfowl and to poultry production, thereby increasing the risk of HPAIv outbreaks. By using fine-scale GPS tracking of Greater Snow Geese (GSGO, N = 59) and Canada Geese (CANG, N = 9) over four winters (2019-2023), we 1) demonstrate a risk ranking system for poultry facilities based on exposure to wintering waterfowl, and 2) model this exposure in relation to temporal, geographic, and land cover factors. We showed that an ordinal-percentile ranking system, based on goose points per hour (gp/h) at poultry facilities, effectively predicted HPAIv H5N1 outbreak risks in the Delmarva Peninsula. Seven facilities with outbreaks were in the 78-99th risk percentile, including one ranked among the top 25 of 6,021 facilities. Such ranking criteria could be used to guide biosecurity efforts when response teams' resources are limited. Notably, one-third of Delmarva poultry facilities had GPS-marked waterfowl present during winters, indicating a significant presence despite our limited sample sizes. We analyzed the variability in goose exposure rates near poultry facilities over four winters. Time (week) during winter was the key predictor of exposure, with greater GSGO presence in mid-late winter (Dec 15 to Feb 28) and CANG exposure peaking in early winter (Nov 28 to Dec 11), then stabilizing until late winter (Feb to Mar 13), whereupon exposure increased again. Colder temperatures (below 0°C) significantly increased GSGO exposure as they sought waste grain for energy. Goose exposure for both species was high throughout the winter, necessitating 24-hour surveillance. Proximity to sewage treatment plants (≤2 km), National Wildlife Refuges (≤5 km), water bodies (≤5 km), and the coast (≤20 km) increased exposure levels. Additionally, inland areas with features such as reservoirs and lakes supported large numbers of geese near facilities.

elements_en.study_design_and_population: The Delmarva Peninsula is vital to wintering waterfowl and to poultry production, thereby increasing the risk of HPAIv outbreaks. By using fine-scale GPS tracking of Greater Snow Geese (GSGO, N = 59) and Canada Geese (CANG, N = 9) over four winters (2019-2023), we 1) demonstrate a risk ranking system for poultry facilities based on exposure to wintering waterfowl, and 2) model this exposure in relation to temporal, geographic, and land cover factors.
elements_en.methods: We analyzed the variability in goose exposure rates near poultry facilities over four winters.
elements_en.main_results: We showed that an ordinal-percentile ranking system, based on goose points per hour (gp/h) at poultry facilities, effectively predicted HPAIv H5N1 outbreak risks in the Delmarva Peninsula. Seven facilities with outbreaks were in the 78-99th risk percentile, including one ranked among the top 25 of 6,021 facilities. Time (week) during winter was the key predictor of exposure, with greater GSGO presence in mid-late winter (Dec 15 to Feb 28) and CANG exposure peaking in early winter (Nov 28 to Dec 11), then stabilizing until late winter (Feb to Mar 13), whereupon exposure increased again. Colder temperatures (below 0°C) significantly increased GSGO exposure as they sought waste grain for energy.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Goose exposure for both species was high throughout the winter, necessitating 24-hour surveillance.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Such ranking criteria could be used to guide biosecurity efforts when response teams' resources are limited. Additionally, inland areas with features such as reservoirs and lakes supported large numbers of geese near facilities.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific limitations to the study design or evidence strength.

papers.title_zh: 使用高频 GPS 数据评估越冬鹅与德尔马瓦半岛商业家禽设施的接近程度,以进行 禽流感 风险管理和 监测。
papers.source_body_en: The ongoing global outbreak of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza Virus (HPAIv) Clade 2.3.4.4 H5N1 in poultry, which was first detected in the United States (USA) in February 2022, underscores the importance of improving food biosecurity and wild bird surveillance. The Delmarva Peninsula is vital to wintering waterfowl and to poultry production, thereby increasing the risk of HPAIv outbreaks. By using fine-scale GPS tracking of Greater Snow Geese (GSGO, N = 59) and Canada Geese (CANG, N = 9) over four winters (2019-2023), we 1) demonstrate a risk ranking system for poultry facilities based on exposure to wintering waterfowl, and 2) model this exposure in relation to temporal, geographic, and land cover factors. We showed that an ordinal-percentile ranking system, based on goose points per hour (gp/h) at poultry facilities, effectively predicted HPAIv H5N1 outbreak risks in the Delmarva Peninsula. Seven facilities with outbreaks were in the 78-99th risk percentile, including one ranked among the top 25 of 6,021 facilities. Such ranking criteria could be used to guide biosecurity efforts when response teams' resources are limited. Notably, one-third of Delmarva poultry facilities had GPS-marked waterfowl present during winters, indicating a significant presence despite our limited sample sizes. We analyzed the variability in goose exposure rates near poultry facilities over four winters. Time (week) during winter was the key predictor of exposure, with greater GSGO presence in mid-late winter (Dec 15 to Feb 28) and CANG exposure peaking in early winter (Nov 28 to Dec 11), then stabilizing until late winter (Feb to Mar 13), whereupon exposure increased again. Colder temperatures (below 0°C) significantly increased GSGO exposure as they sought waste grain for energy. Goose exposure for both species was high throughout the winter, necessitating 24-hour surveillance. Proximity to sewage treatment plants (≤2 km), National Wildlife Refuges (≤5 km), water bodies (≤5 km), and the coast (≤20 km) increased exposure levels. Additionally, inland areas with features such as reservoirs and lakes supported large numbers of geese near facilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 家禽中的 高致病性禽流感 病毒 (HPAIv) 进化枝 2.3.4.4 H5N1 的全球 暴发 正在进行中,该病毒于 2022 年 2 月在美国 (USA) 首次检测到,强调了改善食品生物安全和 野生鸟类 监测 的重要性。德尔马瓦半岛对于越冬水禽和家禽生产至关重要,因此增加了 HPAIv 暴发 的风险。通过使用大雪雁 (GSGO,N = 59) 和加拿大鹅 (CANG,N = 9) 在四个冬天 (2019-2023) 的精细 GPS 跟踪,我们 1) 展示了基于越冬水禽暴露的家禽设施风险排名系统,2) 建立了与时间、地理和土地覆盖因素相关的暴露模型。我们表明,基于家禽设施每小时鹅分数 (gp/h) 的序数百分位排名系统可以有效预测德尔马瓦半岛的 HPAIv H5N1 暴发 风险。7 个带有 暴发 的设施处于第 78-99 个风险百分位,其中一个在 6,021 个设施中排名前 25。当响应团队的资源有限时,此类排名标准可用于指导生物安全工作。值得注意的是,三分之一的德尔马瓦家禽设施在冬季有带有 GPS 标记的水禽,这表明尽管我们的样本量有限,但水禽的存在却很显着。我们分析了四个冬天家禽设施附近鹅暴露率的变化。冬季时间(周)是暴露的关键预测因素,GSGO 在冬中后期(12 月 15 日至 2 月 28 日)出现较多,CANG 暴露在初冬(11 月 28 日至 12 月 11 日)达到峰值,然后稳定到冬末(2 月至 3 月 13 日),随后暴露再次增加。较冷的温度(低于 0°C)显着增加了 GSGO 暴露,因为他们寻找废弃谷物作为能源。整个冬季,这两种鹅的暴露量都很高,需要 24 小时 监测。靠近污水 治疗 工厂(≤2 公里)、国家野生动物保护区(≤5 公里)、水体(≤5 公里)和海岸(≤20 公里)会增加暴露水平。此外,具有 储存宿主 等特征的内陆地区和湖泊在设施附近养育了大量鹅。

papers.title: No Evidence of HPAI H5N1 in Coastal Areas of Australia's Antarctic Territory During the 2025/26 Austral Summer.
papers.abstract: High pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b (hereafter HPAI H5N1) is the cause of a globally devastating animal pandemic (panzootic).Since 2020, HPAI H5N1 has had a substantial range expansion and has now been detected on every continent [1,2].In the Antarctic region, the virus was first identified in the sub-Antarctic (South Georgia Island) in October 2023, with the first confirmed detection in the Antarctic Treaty Area (ATA) occurring on the Antarctic Peninsula a few months later.HPAI H5N1 reoccurred in this region in the austral summer of 2024/2025 and 2025/2026 [3].Considerable expansion of HPAI H5N1 in the sub-Antarctic occurred by the austral summer of 2024/2025 with detections on Gough Island, Marion Island, Kerguelen Island and Crozet Islands [3,4].In the 2025 austral spring, the virus was also detected on Australia's sub-Antarctic Heard Island [5], and in June 2026, this same lineage was confirmed in Australia [1].To date, spread beyond the Antarctic Peninsula to other parts of continental Antarctica has not been observed.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the presence of HPAI H5N1 in the coastal areas of Australia's Antarctic Territory during the 2025/26 austral summer, given the global spread of the virus and its recent detection in the Antarctic region.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on the Antarctic region, specifically the coastal areas of Australia's Antarctic Territory, during the 2025/26 austral summer. It included the Antarctic Peninsula and other sub-Antarctic islands such as Heard Island, where HPAI H5N1 was detected in the 2025 austral spring.

papers.source_body_en: High pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b (hereafter HPAI H5N1) is the cause of a globally devastating animal pandemic (panzootic).Since 2020, HPAI H5N1 has had a substantial range expansion and has now been detected on every continent [1,2].In the Antarctic region, the virus was first identified in the sub-Antarctic (South Georgia Island) in October 2023, with the first confirmed detection in the Antarctic Treaty Area (ATA) occurring on the Antarctic Peninsula a few months later.HPAI H5N1 reoccurred in this region in the austral summer of 2024/2025 and 2025/2026 [3].Considerable expansion of HPAI H5N1 in the sub-Antarctic occurred by the austral summer of 2024/2025 with detections on Gough Island, Marion Island, Kerguelen Island and Crozet Islands [3,4].In the 2025 austral spring, the virus was also detected on Australia's sub-Antarctic Heard Island [5], and in June 2026, this same lineage was confirmed in Australia [1].To date, spread beyond the Antarctic Peninsula to other parts of continental Antarctica has not been observed.

papers.title: Environmental Adaptability of Influenza A(H9N2) Virus in the Process of Genetic Evolution
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Understanding the transmission routes of avian influenza viruses (AIVs) is critical for outbreak control. Beyond direct contact and aerosol transmission, indirect transmission via contaminated environmental surfaces contributes to exposure risk, particularly in live poultry markets (LPMs). Although previous studies have examined the environmental persistence of individual AIV strains, systematic comparisons among genetically related viruses remain scarce. H9N2, designated by the WHO as a potential “Pathogen X,” is of particular concern. Here, we assessed the environmental persistence and indirect transmission potential of four genetically related H9N2 AIVs originating from the same LPM‐associated epidemiological context: one human isolate (H19) and three LPM environmental isolates (E01, E02, E03). All viruses exhibited temperature‐dependent infectivity decay on four surface materials. Notably, H19 and E01 demonstrated prolonged environmental persistence compared with E02 and E03 under multiple conditions. Moreover, smooth, non‐porous surfaces (plastic, glass, stainless steel) generally supported longer viral survival than porous non‐woven fabric. In a guinea pig model, H19 and E01 led to detectable indirect transmission, whereas E02 and E03 did not. Comparative sequence analysis revealed differences at NP‐346 and PB2‐18 between these two phenotypic groups, although the functional relevance of these substitutions remains to be determined. Collectively, these findings reveal that environmental persistence and indirect transmission potential can vary markedly among genetically related LPM‐associated H9N2 AIVs, supporting the integration of environmental adaptability into routine risk assessment frameworks.

Beyond direct contact and aerosol transmission, indirect transmission via contaminated environmental surfaces contributes to exposure risk, particularly in live poultry markets (LPMs). Although previous studies have examined the environmental persistence of individual AIV strains, systematic comparisons among genetically related viruses remain scarce. H9N2, designated by the WHO as a potential “Pathogen X,” is of particular concern. Here, we assessed the environmental persistence and indirect transmission potential of four genetically related H9N2 AIVs originating from the same LPM‐associated epidemiological context: one human isolate (H19) and three LPM environmental isolates (E01, E02, E03). All viruses exhibited temperature‐dependent infectivity decay on four surface materials. Notably, H19 and E01 demonstrated prolonged environmental persistence compared with E02 and E03 under multiple conditions. Moreover, smooth, non‐porous surfaces (plastic, glass, stainless steel) generally supported longer viral survival than porous non‐woven fabric. In a guinea pig model, H19 and E01 led to detectable indirect transmission, whereas E02 and E03 did not. Comparative sequence analysis revealed differences at NP‐346 and PB2‐18 between these two phenotypic groups, although the functional relevance of these substitutions remains to be determined. Collectively, these findings reveal that environmental persistence and indirect transmission potential can vary markedly among genetically related LPM‐associated H9N2 AIVs, supporting the integration of environmental adaptability into routine risk assessment frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 了解 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) 的 传播 途径对于控制 暴发 至关重要。除了直接接触和气溶胶 传播 之外,通过受污染的环境表面间接接触 传播 也会增加暴露风险,特别是在活家禽市场 (LPM) 中。尽管之前的研究已经检验了单个禽流感病毒株的环境持久性,但遗传相关病毒之间的系统比较仍然很少。H9N2 被世界卫生组织指定为潜在的“X 病原体”,尤其值得关注。在这里,我们评估了源自相同 LPM 相关流行病学背景的四种遗传相关 H9N2 AIV 的环境持久性和间接 传播 潜力:一种人类分离株(H19)和三种 LPM 环境分离株(E01、E02、E03)。所有病毒在四种表面材料上都表现出与温度相关的感染性衰减。值得注意的是,与 E02 和 E03 相比,H19 和 E01 在多种条件下表现出更长的环境持久性。此外,光滑、无孔表面(塑料、玻璃、不锈钢)通常比多孔无纺布支持更长的病毒存活时间。在豚鼠模型中,H19 和 E01 导致可检测到的间接 传播,而 E02 和 E03 则没有。比较序列分析揭示了这两个表型组之间 NP-346 和 PB2-18 的差异,尽管这些替换的功能相关性仍有待确定。总的来说,这些发现表明,在遗传相关的 LPM 相关 H9N2 AIV 中,环境持久性和间接 传播 潜力可能存在显着差异,支持将环境适应性纳入常规风险评估框架。

papers.title: Compensatory Mutations in Avian Influenza H7N1 Hemagglutinin Drive Avian Host Adaptation and Antigenic Drift without Enhancing Replication in Human Cells
papers.abstract: Abstract Avian influenza A viruses (AIVs) of the H7 subtype have caused outbreaks in poultry and human ranging from mild to fatal disease. In Europe, H7 viruses have demonstrated an unusual capacity for prolonged circulation in poultry, most notably during the Italian H7N1 epizootic (1999–2001), which persisted despite control measures and provides a model to study viral adaptation under sustained immune pressure. Here, we investigated the genetic and functional evolution of hemagglutinin (HA) in Italian H7N1 viruses collected from chickens and turkeys. Phylogenetic analysis identified a turkey-associated lineage carrying six HA1 substitutions (E95G, T125V, R130K, G133E, A151T, G177V), detectable at low frequency in early LPAIV quasispecies, suggesting selection from pre-existing variants. Using reverse genetics, we demonstrate that these mutations act through compensatory and epistatic interactions to enhance viral fitness in vitro and in ovo, with stronger effects in turkey-derived cells and embryos than in chickens. While T125V alone reduced avian receptor binding and replication, the full HA1 substitution set restored replication in avian systems and conferred a competitive advantage in turkey embryos. These substitutions altered HA glycosylation, modulated fusion activity and thermal stability, and induced marked antigenic drift relative to a heterologous H7 vaccine strain. Despite extensive HA remodeling, glycan microarray analysis and molecular dynamics simulations confirmed strict maintenance of avian-type (α2,3-linked) sialic acid receptor specificity, without increased binding to human-type receptors or enhanced replication. Together, these findings demonstrate how H7 viruses adapt during prolonged poultry circulation by balancing fitness, immune escape, and host specificity without increasing zoonotic potential.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Avian influenza A viruses (AIVs) of the H7 subtype have caused outbreaks in poultry and human ranging from mild to fatal disease. The study aimed to understand how these viruses adapt during prolonged circulation in avian hosts.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on Italian H7N1 viruses collected from chickens and turkeys during the 1999–2001 epizootic, which persisted despite control measures and provides a model to study viral adaptation under sustained immune pressure.
analysis.methods: Phylogenetic analysis was used to identify a turkey-associated lineage carrying six HA1 substitutions. Reverse genetics was employed to demonstrate the functional effects of these mutations on viral fitness in vitro and in ovo.
analysis.main_results: Phylogenetic analysis identified a turkey-associated lineage carrying six HA1 substitutions (E95G, T125V, R130K, G133E, A151T, G177V), detectable at low frequency in early LPAIV quasispecies. These substitutions altered HA glycosylation, modulated fusion activity and thermal stability, and induced marked antigenic drift relative to a heterologous H7 vaccine strain.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate how H7 viruses adapt during prolonged poultry circulation by balancing fitness, immune escape, and host specificity without increasing zoonotic potential. The study highlights the role of compensatory and epistatic interactions in viral evolution.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the mechanisms of avian influenza adaptation and antigenic drift, which can inform surveillance and vaccine development strategies for avian influenza viruses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on in vitro and in ovo experiments, which may not fully represent natural host interactions. The evidence is moderate, as the findings are derived from a single epizootic event and limited host models.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the genetic and functional evolution of hemagglutinin (HA) in Italian H7N1 avian influenza viruses collected from chickens and turkeys during the 1999–2001 epizootic. Phylogenetic analysis identified a turkey-associated lineage with six HA1 substitutions, which were shown to enhance viral fitness in avian systems through compensatory and epistatic interactions. These mutations altered HA glycosylation, fusion activity, and thermal stability, leading to antigenic drift relative to a heterologous H7 vaccine strain. The study demonstrates how H7 viruses adapt during prolonged poultry circulation by balancing fitness, immune escape, and host specificity without increasing zoonotic potential. The findings provide insights into the mechanisms of avian influenza adaptation and antigenic drift, which can inform surveillance and vaccine development strategies. However, the study is limited to in vitro and in ovo experiments, which may not fully capture natural host interactions, resulting in moderate confidence in the conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 禽流感 H7 亚型病毒 (AIV) 已在家禽和人类中引起 暴发 疾病,范围从轻微到致命。该研究旨在了解这些病毒在禽类 宿主 中的长期循环过程中如何适应。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究重点关注 1999 年至 2001 年动物流行期间从鸡和火鸡中收集的意大利 H7N1 病毒,尽管采取了控制措施,但该病毒仍然持续存在,并提供了研究病毒在持续免疫压力下适应的模型。
elements_zh.methods: 系统发育分析用于鉴定携带六个 HA1 取代的火鸡相关谱系。采用反向遗传学来证明这些 突变 对体外和卵内病毒适应性的功能影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析鉴定出一个与火鸡相关的谱系携带六个 HA1 取代(E95G、T125V、R130K、G133E、A151T、G177V),在早期 LPAIV 准种中可低频率检测到。这些取代改变了 HA 糖基化,调节融合活性和热稳定性,并诱导相对于异源 H7 疫苗 菌株的显着抗原漂移。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,H7 病毒如何通过平衡适应性、免疫逃逸和 宿主 特异性来适应长时间的家禽循环,而不增加人畜共患病的可能性。该研究强调了病毒 进化 中补偿性和上位性相互作用的作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果提供了对 禽流感 适应和抗原漂移机制的深入了解,这可以为 禽流感 病毒的 监测 和 疫苗 开发策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于体外和卵内实验,可能无法完全代表自然的 宿主 相互作用。证据是中等的,因为研究结果来自单个动物流行事件和有限的 宿主 模型。

These substitutions altered HA glycosylation, modulated fusion activity and thermal stability, and induced marked antigenic drift relative to a heterologous H7 vaccine strain. Despite extensive HA remodeling, glycan microarray analysis and molecular dynamics simulations confirmed strict maintenance of avian-type (α2,3-linked) sialic acid receptor specificity, without increased binding to human-type receptors or enhanced replication. Together, these findings demonstrate how H7 viruses adapt during prolonged poultry circulation by balancing fitness, immune escape, and host specificity without increasing zoonotic potential.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 H7亚型禽流感病毒(AIVs)可在禽类和人类中引发从轻症到致死性疾病的禽流感。在欧洲,H7病毒展现出在禽类中长期循环的非同寻常能力,最典型的案例为意大利H7N1动物流行病(1999–2001年),该疫情在采取控制措施后仍持续流行,为研究病毒在持续免疫压力下的适应过程提供了模型。本研究调查了从鸡和火鸡分离的意大利H7N1病毒血凝素(HA)的遗传与功能进化。系统发育分析识别出一个火鸡相关的进化支,其HA1携带6个氨基酸替代(E95G、T125V、R130K、G133E、A151T、G177V),这些替代在早期低致病性禽流感准种中以低频率检测到,提示其源自既存变异的选择。通过反向遗传学,我们证明这些突变通过补偿与上位互作增强了病毒在体外和鸡胚中的复制适合度,在火鸡来源的细胞和胚胎中效应强于鸡。尽管T125V单独可降低禽类受体结合与复制能力,但完整的HA1替代组合可在禽类系统中恢复复制能力并赋予火鸡胚胎中的竞争优势。这些替代改变了HA糖基化模式,调节了融合活性与热稳定性,并相对于异源H7 疫苗毒株诱导了显著的抗原漂移。尽管HA发生了广泛重塑,糖基化芯片分析与分子动力学模拟仍证实其严格维持禽类型(α2,3连接)唾液酸受体特异性,未出现对人类型受体结合或复制能力增强。综上,本研究证明H7病毒在禽类长期流行过程中如何通过平衡适合度、免疫逃逸与受体特异性维持,在不提升人兽共患潜能的前提下实现适应。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 禽流感 H7 亚型病毒 (AIV) 已在家禽和人类中引起 暴发 疾病,范围从轻微到致命。该研究旨在了解这些病毒在禽类 宿主 中的长期循环过程中如何适应。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究重点关注 1999 年至 2001 年动物流行期间从鸡和火鸡中收集的意大利 H7N1 病毒,尽管采取了控制措施,但该病毒仍然持续存在,并提供了研究病毒在持续免疫压力下适应的模型。
analysis_zh.methods: 系统发育分析用于鉴定携带六个 HA1 取代的火鸡相关谱系。采用反向遗传学来证明这些 突变 对体外和卵内病毒适应性的功能影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析鉴定出一个与火鸡相关的谱系携带六个 HA1 取代(E95G、T125V、R130K、G133E、A151T、G177V),在早期 LPAIV 准种中可低频率检测到。这些取代改变了 HA 糖基化,调节融合活性和热稳定性,并诱导相对于异源 H7 疫苗 菌株的显着抗原漂移。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,H7 病毒如何通过平衡适应性、免疫逃逸和 宿主 特异性来适应长时间的家禽循环,而不增加人畜共患病的可能性。该研究强调了病毒 进化 中补偿性和上位性相互作用的作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果提供了对 禽流感 适应和抗原漂移机制的深入了解,这可以为 禽流感 病毒的 监测 和 疫苗 开发策略提供信息。

papers.title: Lessons Learned During the 2024‒2025 Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A(H5N1) Virus Outbreak Response in the United States: The Experience of State and Local Public Health Departments.
papers.abstract: To describe challenges and lessons learned during state and local health department responses to the 2024‒2025 highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) outbreaks. We conducted semistructured interviews from August to November 2025 with Department of Health and Agriculture staff from states with confirmed or probable A(H5N1) human cases. We conducted 15 total interviews with 37 participants from 10 US states. Interview transcripts were inductively and deductively coded to identify generalizable lessons that might improve future outbreak response efforts. Key themes included difficulty accessing farms and reaching at-risk populations; lack of sufficient guidelines for proactively responding to zoonotic outbreaks that could have human health implications; the importance of maintaining preparedness planning, capacity, and infrastructure; and uncertainty around future capacity to respond to outbreaks because of resource constraints and changes in federal leadership. Although this study focused on responses to A(H5N1) outbreaks, the findings are indicative of the nation's overall readiness for biological threats. Prioritization of capacity building for infectious disease outbreaks, including robust health department funding to support continued disease surveillance, is critical to prevent more widespread transmission. (Am J Public Health. Published online ahead of print September 3, 2026:e1-e7. https://doi.org/10.2105/AJPH.2026.308656).

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to describe challenges and lessons learned during state and local health department responses to the 2024‒2025 highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) outbreaks, addressing the need to improve preparedness for biological threats.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as highlighting the need for improved guidelines and infrastructure to address zoonotic outbreaks with potential human health implications. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform future preparedness planning and resource allocation for infectious disease outbreaks, particularly those with zoonotic potential, by emphasizing the importance of robust health department funding and infrastructure.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the challenges and lessons learned during the 2024‒2025 highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) outbreaks in the United States, focusing on the experiences of state and local health departments. The study's implications suggest that strengthening surveillance and capacity for infectious disease outbreaks is critical to preventing widespread transmission. analysis_zh.main_results: 确定的关键主题包括难以进入农场和接触高危人群,缺乏足够的指导方针来主动应对对人类健康产生影响的人畜共患 暴发,维持备灾计划、能力和基础设施的重要性,以及由于资源限制和联邦领导层变化而导致未来应对 暴发 能力的不确定性。

papers.title: Outcome of low pathogenicity avian influenza (H7N9) experimental infection of urban and rural house sparrows (Passer domesticus) is impacted by natural Avipoxvirus infection
papers.abstract: Abstract The house sparrow ( Passer domesticus ), a ubiquitous but declining species, is a potential bridge host for introduction of avian influenza virus (AIV) into poultry farms. We investigated the influence of diet and urban vs rural habitat on susceptibility to and persistence of AIV infection. Wild captured sparrows were inoculated intrachoanally with H7N9 LPAIV (A/Anas crecca/Spain/1460/2008), while control birds received saline. Swab and blood samples collected on 0, 1, 3, 4, 7, 10 and 14 days post-inoculation (dpi), and vascular feathers (1, 7 dpi) from 25% of individuals per group were tested by real-time RT-PCR. Although clinical signs were mild or absent, unexpected mortality (8.3%, 3/36) occurred starting at 4 dpi in urban and 7 dpi in rural sparrows. Viral shedding was observed between 1 and 4 dpi and seroconversion was confirmed in both inoculated groups. Natural Avipoxvirus (APV) infection was evidenced in all experimental groups, by histology, PCR and sequencing. Three distinct APV lineages were detected in oral swabs from urban and rural control birds, on 1 dpi. APV prevalence was higher and persisted longer in LPAIV-infected sparrows, with APV detection overlapping the peaks of LPAIV shedding in both urban and rural birds. These results confirm that urban and rural sparrows are similarly susceptible to experimental H7N9 LPAIV infection. Increased prevalence and persistence of APV during LPAIV infection suggest interaction between these viruses. Such interactions may represent an ecologically relevant but often overlooked component of avian influenza epidemiology and should be considered when evaluating sparrows as potential bridge hosts.

The study's findings are moderate in strength due to its controlled experimental design and lack of natural exposure conditions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查饮食和城市与农村栖息地对 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) 感染易感性和持续性的影响,因为家麻雀 (Passer Domesticus) 是将 宿主 病毒引入家禽养殖场的潜在桥梁。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及对野生捕获的麻雀进行鼻孔内接种 H7N9 LPAIV (A/Anas crecca/Spain/1460/2008),而对照鸟则接受盐水接种。实验在接种后14天进行,总共36只鸡分为实验组和对照组。
elements_zh.methods: 在接种后的特定天(0、1、3、4、7、10 和 14 dpi)收集拭子和血液样本,并通过实时 RT-PCR 检测每组 25% 个体的血管羽毛。通过组织学、PCR 和测序,所有实验组都证明了天然禽痘病毒 (APV) 感染。
elements_zh.main_results: 从 4 dpi 开始,8.3% (3/36) 的城市麻雀和从 7 dpi 开始的农村麻雀出现意外的 死亡率。在 1 至 4 dpi 之间观察到病毒脱落,并且在两个接种组中均证实了血清转化。1 dpi 时,在城市和农村对照鸟类的口腔拭子中检测到三种不同的 APV 谱系。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果表明,自然禽痘病毒(APV)感染可能与 H7N9 LPAIV 感染相互作用,因为 LPAIV 感染的麻雀中 APV 患病率 较高且持续时间较长,并且 APV 检测与城市和乡村鸟类中 LPAIV 脱落的峰值重叠。

papers.title_zh: 城乡麻雀低致病性禽流感(H7N9)实验性感染结果受禽痘病毒自然感染的影响
papers.source_body_en: Abstract The house sparrow ( Passer domesticus ), a ubiquitous but declining species, is a potential bridge host for introduction of avian influenza virus (AIV) into poultry farms. We investigated the influence of diet and urban vs rural habitat on susceptibility to and persistence of AIV infection. Wild captured sparrows were inoculated intrachoanally with H7N9 LPAIV (A/Anas crecca/Spain/1460/2008), while control birds received saline. Swab and blood samples collected on 0, 1, 3, 4, 7, 10 and 14 days post-inoculation (dpi), and vascular feathers (1, 7 dpi) from 25% of individuals per group were tested by real-time RT-PCR. Although clinical signs were mild or absent, unexpected mortality (8.3%, 3/36) occurred starting at 4 dpi in urban and 7 dpi in rural sparrows. Viral shedding was observed between 1 and 4 dpi and seroconversion was confirmed in both inoculated groups. Natural Avipoxvirus (APV) infection was evidenced in all experimental groups, by histology, PCR and sequencing. Three distinct APV lineages were detected in oral swabs from urban and rural control birds, on 1 dpi. APV prevalence was higher and persisted longer in LPAIV-infected sparrows, with APV detection overlapping the peaks of LPAIV shedding in both urban and rural birds. These results confirm that urban and rural sparrows are similarly susceptible to experimental H7N9 LPAIV infection. Increased prevalence and persistence of APV during LPAIV infection suggest interaction between these viruses. Such interactions may represent an ecologically relevant but often overlooked component of avian influenza epidemiology and should be considered when evaluating sparrows as potential bridge hosts.

papers.title: Influenza A virus H5N1 genotypes B3.13 and D1.1 show temperature-dependent restriction of replication in primary human respiratory epithelial cell cultures derived from the upper and lower respiratory tract
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b avian influenza A viruses pose a significant threat to wild animal populations, domesticated animals, and potentially, the human population. For H5N1s to infect and transmit among mammalian species, mutations for improved utilization of mammalian receptors and enhanced replication at the lower temperatures of the upper respiratory tract need to be acquired. A human H1N1pdm09-like virus was compared to H5N1 genotypes B3.13 and D1.1 for replication at 33°C, 37°C, and 39°C – temperatures consistent with the upper and lower respiratory tract in humans, and dairy cow udder tissue. All H5N1 viruses had increased plaque sizes on MDCK cells at 37°C and 39°C compared to H1N1pdm09. In primary, differentiated human nasal and bronchial epithelial cultures, all H5N1 viruses show restricted infectious virus production compared to H1N1 at 33°C. While H5N1 D1.1 also showed restricted replication at 37°C and 39°C, the H5N1 B3.13 replicated to nearly equivalent titers as H1N1pdm09. All H5N1 viruses demonstrated similar cell tropism in cells from the upper and lower respiratory tract, infecting more ciliated than non-ciliated cells relative to H1N1pdm09. H1N1, H5N1 B3.13 D1.1 infection induced similar innate immune factors, with nasal epithelial cells producing higher levels compared to bronchial epithelial cells. These data suggest that genotype B3.13 and D1.1 H5N1 viruses show different temperature dependent replication patterns compared to H1N1pdm09. IMPORTANCE The ongoing H5N1 outbreaks have increased the number of mammalian infections with H5N1, thus increasing the chances of the virus adapting to mammals. Two H5N1 genotypes that have recently infected dairy cows, commercial poultry flocks, and a limited number of humans in the United States showed decreased replication at 33°C but not 37°C or 39°C compared to human H1N1 virus. H5N1 virus replication was detected at all temperatures, suggesting temperature and not host species may be the primary barrier preventing H5N1 infection in humans.

source_records.abstract: ABSTRACT H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b avian influenza A viruses pose a significant threat to wild animal populations, domesticated animals, and potentially, the human population. A human H1N1pdm09-like virus was compared to H5N1 genotypes B3.13 and D1.1 for replication at 33°C, 37°C, and 39°C – temperatures consistent with the upper and lower respiratory tract in humans, and dairy cow udder tissue. All H5N1 viruses had increased plaque sizes on MDCK cells at 37°C and 39°C compared to H1N1pdm09. In primary, differentiated human nasal and bronchial epithelial cultures, all H5N1 viruses show restricted infectious virus production compared to H1N1 at 33°C. While H5N1 D1.1 also showed restricted replication at 37°C and 39°C, the H5N1 B3.13 replicated to nearly equivalent titers as H1N1pdm09. These data suggest that genotype B3.13 and D1.1 H5N1 viruses show different temperature dependent replication patterns compared to H1N1pdm09. H5N1 virus replication was detected at all temperatures, suggesting temperature and not host species may be the primary barrier preventing H5N1 infection in humans.

analysis.methods: The researchers evaluated the replication of H5N1 genotypes B3.13 and D1.1 at 33°C, 37°C, and 39°C using primary human respiratory epithelial cell cultures. analysis.main_results: All H5N1 viruses had increased plaque sizes on MDCK cells at 37°C and 39°C compared to H1N1pdm09. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that genotype B3.13 and D1.1 H5N1 viruses show different temperature-dependent replication patterns compared to H1N1pdm09. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the replication dynamics of H5N1 viruses in human respiratory cell cultures, which could inform surveillance and risk assessment strategies for zoonotic influenza transmission. analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the replication characteristics of H5N1 avian influenza A virus genotypes B3.13 and D1.1 in primary human respiratory epithelial cell cultures at different temperatures. The research highlights the potential of these H5N1 genotypes to infect mammalian species, with findings indicating that temperature may be a critical factor in their replication capacity. The study compares these viruses to a human H1N1pdm09-like virus, revealing differences in their replication efficiency at 33°C, 37°C, and 39°C. These results suggest that temperature-dependent replication patterns may influence the ability of H5N1 viruses to infect humans, contributing to the understanding of zoonotic transmission risks. The study's in vitro design limits its generalizability to real-world scenarios, but the consistent replication patterns observed across multiple conditions support a moderate confidence in the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在通过检查 H5N1 禽流感 A 病毒在不同温度下的复制特性来研究 H5N1 禽流感 A 病毒在哺乳动物物种之间感染和传播的潜力。H5N1 进化枝 2.3.4.4b 禽流感 A 病毒对野生动物种群、家养动物以及潜在的人类种群构成重大威胁。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究比较了 H5N1 基因型 B3.13 和 D1.1 与人类 H1N1pdm09 样病毒在来自上呼吸道和下呼吸道的原代人呼吸道上皮细胞培养物中的复制情况。该研究是在实验室环境中使用分化的人类鼻和支气管上皮培养物进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用原代人呼吸道上皮细胞培养物评估了 H5N1 基因型 B3.13 和 D1.1 在 33°C、37°C​​ 和 39°C 下的复制情况。他们测量了 MDCK 细胞上的噬菌斑大小,并评估了分化的人鼻和支气管上皮培养物中感染性病毒的产生。
elements_zh.main_results: 与 H1N1pdm09 相比,所有 H5N1 病毒在 37°C 和 39°C 的 MDCK 细胞上的噬斑大小均有所增加。在原代、分化的人鼻和支气管上皮培养物中,与 H1N1pdm09 相比,所有 H5N1 病毒在 33°C 下的感染性病毒产量均受到限制。H5N1 D1.1 在 37°C 和 39°C 时也表现出有限的复制,而 H5N1 B3.13 的复制滴度几乎与 H1N1pdm09 相同。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,与 H1N1pdm09 相比,基因型 B3.13 和 D1.1 H5N1 病毒表现出不同的温度依赖性复制模式。这些数据表明,温度可能是影响H5N1病毒在哺乳动物宿主中复制的关键因素。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果提供了对 H5N1 病毒在人类呼吸道细胞培养物中复制动态的深入了解,这可以为 监测 和人畜共患流感 传播 的风险评估策略提供信息。他们还强调了温度在确定 H5N1 感染人类的​​可能性方面的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是使用原代人呼吸道上皮细胞培养物在体外进行的,这可能无法完全代表体内条件。该证据基于对复制模式的直接观察,并得到多项结果的支持,表明研究结果具有中等可信度。

papers.title: Evidence of long- range airborne transport of the avian influenza virus
papers.abstract: Background: HE-FARM is a European project aimed at enhancing biosecurity along the farm-to-fork chain. It focuses on detecting pathogenic aerosols by developing innovative air sampling techniques. One of the key pathogens of concern in this context is the highly pathogenic avian influenza virus, which can have extensive impacts on the poultry industry. Methods During the highly pathogenic avian influenza outbreak in Spain in autumn 2025, air sampling was carried out around a poultry farm confirmed to be infected, during depopulation operations. Samples were collected using a Counterfog BIAFTS air sampler positioned 150 meters from the farm. Results PCR analysis detected the influenza viral genome in three out of three samples and the H5 subtype in two out of three samples. Conclusions The presence of H5-influenza aerosols positive at this distance provides strong evidence that viral particles can be dispersed through the air beyond the immediate vicinity of infected farms. These results suggest that airborne transport may play a role in virus transmission between farms.

papers.title: H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1e lineage transition in Lao PDR during 2023–2024 associated with regional spread and human infection risk-associated receptor-binding features
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 viruses clade 2.3.2.1e has re-emerged in the Indochinese Peninsula, raising concerns about regional spread and zoonotic risk. We characterized eight H5N1 viruses isolated from 32 environmental and poultry-derived samples collected in Lao People’s Democratic Republic (Lao PDR) live bird markets during 2023–2024. Whole-genome and phylogenetic analyses showed that all isolates belonged to clade 2.3.2.1e and were distinct from the previously dominant Lao clade 2.3.2.1c, indicating lineage transition in poultry-associated viruses. The Lao isolates were distributed across regional sublineages rather than forming a single local cluster, suggesting repeated introductions and cross-border genetic connectivity. Segment-level nucleotide identities ranged from 97.2 to 99.9%, revealing a complex mosaic genotype constellation. All isolates retained the avian-associated glutamic acid residue at position 627 of polymerase basic protein 2 (PB2-627E) and the aspartic acid residue at position 701 of polymerase basic protein 2 (PB2-701D). Hemagglutinin (HA) analysis showed a conserved polybasic cleavage motif, PQRERRRKRGLF, and conserved HA1-123S, HA1-154N, HA1-263T, and HA2-497L, whereas isolate-level variation was observed at HA1-94, HA1-188, and HA1-223. Structural modeling and Molecular Mechanics-Generalized Born Surface Area (MM-GBSA) analysis of a representative isolate further highlighted receptor binding site (RBS) associated HA features. Importantly, RBS-associated HA variation was detected despite the absence of lysine residue at position 627 of polymerase basic protein 2 (PB2-627 K), suggesting that early molecular changes relevant to mammalian or human adaptation may arise before acquisition of canonical mammalian-adaptive polymerase mutations. These findings support sustained cross-border genomic surveillance and receptor-binding-focused characterization of H5N1 viruses circulating in Lao live bird markets.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the emergence of H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1e in Lao PDR and its implications for regional spread and human infection risk. analysis.study_design_and_population: The study characterized eight H5N1 viruses isolated from 32 environmental and poultry-derived samples collected in Lao PDR live bird markets during 2023–2024. These isolates were analyzed to determine their genetic lineage and potential for human infection.
analysis.methods: Whole-genome and phylogenetic analyses were conducted to classify the isolates and identify lineage transitions. Segment-level nucleotide identities were calculated to assess genetic diversity, and structural modeling and MM-GBSA analysis were used to examine receptor-binding site (RBS) features of a representative isolate.
analysis.main_results: All isolates belonged to clade 2.3.2.1e and were distinct from the previously dominant Lao clade 2.3.2.1c, indicating a lineage transition. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the dynamic genetic evolution of H5N1 viruses in Lao PDR, with lineage transition and regional sublineage distribution indicating ongoing cross-border genetic exchange and potential for increased human infection risk.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results emphasize the need for sustained genomic surveillance and receptor-binding characterization of H5N1 viruses in live bird markets to better understand their potential for human adaptation and zoonotic transmission.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which may limit the depth of analysis. However, the findings are supported by whole-genome and phylogenetic analyses, providing moderate confidence in the observed lineage transition and genetic features.

elements_zh.methods: 进行全 基因组 和系统发育分析来对分离株进行分类并鉴定谱系转变。计算片段水平核苷酸同一性以评估遗传多样性,并使用结构建模和 MM-GBSA 分析来检查代表性分离株的受体结合位点 (RBS) 特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有分离株均属于进化枝 2.3.2.1e,与之前占主导地位的老挝进化枝 2.3.2.1c 不同,表明存在谱系过渡。老挝分离株分布在各个区域亚谱系中,而不是形成一个单一的本地簇,这表明重复引入和跨境遗传连通性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了老挝人民民主共和国 H5N1 病毒的动态遗传 进化,其谱系转变和区域亚谱系分布表明正在进行的跨境遗传交换以及人类感染风险增加的可能性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果强调需要对活禽市场中的 H5N1 病毒进行持续的 基因组监测 和受体结合表征,以更好地了解它们对人类适应和人畜共患 传播 的潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅基于抽象证据,这可能会限制分析的深度。然而,这些发现得到了全 基因组 和系统发育分析的支持,为观察到的谱系转变和遗传特征提供了适度的可信度。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the emergence of H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1e in Lao PDR and its implications for regional spread and human infection risk. High pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 viruses clade 2.3.2.1e have re-emerged in the Indochinese Peninsula, raising concerns about regional spread and zoonotic risk.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study characterized eight H5N1 viruses isolated from 32 environmental and poultry-derived samples collected in Lao PDR live bird markets during 2023–2024. These isolates were analyzed to determine their genetic lineage and potential for human infection.
analysis_en.methods: Whole-genome and phylogenetic analyses were conducted to classify the isolates and identify lineage transitions. Segment-level nucleotide identities were calculated to assess genetic diversity, and structural modeling and MM-GBSA analysis were used to examine receptor-binding site (RBS) features of a representative isolate.
analysis_en.main_results: All isolates belonged to clade 2.3.2.1e and were distinct from the previously dominant Lao clade 2.3.2.1c, indicating a lineage transition. The Lao isolates were distributed across regional sublineages rather than forming a single local cluster, suggesting repeated introductions and cross-border genetic connectivity.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the dynamic genetic evolution of H5N1 viruses in Lao PDR, with lineage transition and regional sublineage distribution indicating ongoing cross-border genetic exchange and potential for increased human infection risk.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results emphasize the need for sustained genomic surveillance and receptor-binding characterization of H5N1 viruses in live bird markets to better understand their potential for human adaptation and zoonotic transmission.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which may limit the depth of analysis. However, the findings are supported by whole-genome and phylogenetic analyses, providing moderate confidence in the observed lineage transition and genetic features.

papers.title_zh: 2023–2024年老挝人民民主共和国境内H5N1亚型2.3.2.1e分支的谱系转换与区域传播及人感染风险相关受体结合特征
papers.source_body_en: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 viruses clade 2.3.2.1e has re-emerged in the Indochinese Peninsula, raising concerns about regional spread and zoonotic risk. We characterized eight H5N1 viruses isolated from 32 environmental and poultry-derived samples collected in Lao People’s Democratic Republic (Lao PDR) live bird markets during 2023–2024. Whole-genome and phylogenetic analyses showed that all isolates belonged to clade 2.3.2.1e and were distinct from the previously dominant Lao clade 2.3.2.1c, indicating lineage transition in poultry-associated viruses. The Lao isolates were distributed across regional sublineages rather than forming a single local cluster, suggesting repeated introductions and cross-border genetic connectivity. Segment-level nucleotide identities ranged from 97.2 to 99.9%, revealing a complex mosaic genotype constellation. All isolates retained the avian-associated glutamic acid residue at position 627 of polymerase basic protein 2 (PB2-627E) and the aspartic acid residue at position 701 of polymerase basic protein 2 (PB2-701D). Hemagglutinin (HA) analysis showed a conserved polybasic cleavage motif, PQRERRRKRGLF, and conserved HA1-123S, HA1-154N, HA1-263T, and HA2-497L, whereas isolate-level variation was observed at HA1-94, HA1-188, and HA1-223. Structural modeling and Molecular Mechanics-Generalized Born Surface Area (MM-GBSA) analysis of a representative isolate further highlighted receptor binding site (RBS) associated HA features. Importantly, RBS-associated HA variation was detected despite the absence of lysine residue at position 627 of polymerase basic protein 2 (PB2-627 K), suggesting that early molecular changes relevant to mammalian or human adaptation may arise before acquisition of canonical mammalian-adaptive polymerase mutations. These findings support sustained cross-border genomic surveillance and receptor-binding-focused characterization of H5N1 viruses circulating in Lao live bird markets.

papers.title: Mechanism-based prediction of insertion-driven high pathogenicity avian influenza virus emergence
papers.abstract: Abstract High pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (HPAIVs) emerge from H5 and H7 low-pathogenicity avian influenza virus progenitors through mutations that introduce a multibasic cleavage site in haemagglutinin. Although nucleotide insertions recurrently generate this motif, the molecular determinants of insertion and whether particular HA sequences are genetically predisposed to evolve toward HPAIV remain unknown. Combining experimental virology and thermodynamic modelling, we show that insertions arise through polymerase slippage controlled by local product–template duplex thermodynamics within the viral polymerase catalytic site. Predicted RNA secondary structures outside the polymerase are not required for high-frequency insertions and only modestly modulate insertion rates. We formalize this mechanism in HPAIVpredict, which predicts insertion profiles, recapitulates intermediates associated with documented HPAIV emergence events and identifies H5 and H7 sequence backgrounds predisposed to acquire functional multibasic cleavage sites.

elements_zh.methods: 研究人员利用实验病毒学和热力学模型证明插入是通过聚合酶滑动发生的,聚合酶滑动受到病毒聚合酶催化位点内局部产物-模板双链体热力学的影响。他们还评估了聚合酶外部的 RNA 二级结构在调节插入率中的作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,插入通过聚合酶滑移产生,该过程受病毒聚合酶催化位点内产物-模板双链热力学控制。预测的聚合酶外RNA二级结构并非高频插入所必需,仅对插入率产生适度调节作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将其发现形式化为 HPAIVpredict 工具,该工具可识别 H5 和 H7 血清型序列背景中易于获取功能性多碱性裂解位点的倾向,从而为高致病性禽流感病毒出现提供一种新颖的机制驱动预测方法。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study combined experimental virology and thermodynamic modelling to investigate the mechanism of insertion-driven HPAIV emergence, focusing on avian influenza A viruses and their genetic sequences. It examined H5 and H7 subtypes, which are known progenitors of HPAIVs.
analysis_en.methods: The researchers used experimental virology and thermodynamic modelling to demonstrate that insertions occur through polymerase slippage, which is influenced by local product–template duplex thermodynamics within the viral polymerase catalytic site. analysis_en.main_results: The study found that insertions arise through polymerase slippage controlled by local product–template duplex thermodynamics within the viral polymerase catalytic site. Predicted RNA secondary structures outside the polymerase were not required for high-frequency insertions and only modestly modulated insertion rates.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors formalized their findings into HPAIVpredict, a tool that identifies H5 and H7 sequence backgrounds predisposed to acquiring functional multibasic cleavage sites, thereby providing a novel mechanism-based prediction for HPAIV emergence.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance and risk assessment strategies for HPAIV emergence by identifying genetic predispositions in H5 and H7 subtypes. This could aid in early detection and prevention efforts.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which limits the depth of analysis. However, the mechanism is supported by experimental virology and thermodynamic modelling, providing a moderate level of confidence in its conclusions.

papers.source_body_en: Abstract High pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (HPAIVs) emerge from H5 and H7 low-pathogenicity avian influenza virus progenitors through mutations that introduce a multibasic cleavage site in haemagglutinin. Although nucleotide insertions recurrently generate this motif, the molecular determinants of insertion and whether particular HA sequences are genetically predisposed to evolve toward HPAIV remain unknown. Combining experimental virology and thermodynamic modelling, we show that insertions arise through polymerase slippage controlled by local product–template duplex thermodynamics within the viral polymerase catalytic site. Predicted RNA secondary structures outside the polymerase are not required for high-frequency insertions and only modestly modulate insertion rates. We formalize this mechanism in HPAIVpredict, which predicts insertion profiles, recapitulates intermediates associated with documented HPAIV emergence events and identifies H5 and H7 sequence backgrounds predisposed to acquire functional multibasic cleavage sites.

papers.title: Newton Divided Difference Optimization for Fingerprint-Based Neural Virtual Screening against Avian Influenza A/H9N2
papers.abstract: Avian influenza A/H9N2 poses persistent zoonotic and veterinary threats, yet efficient computational tools for antiviral compound prioritization remain underdeveloped, particularly with respect to optimizer behavior in high-dimensional neural screening. This study proposes Newton Divided Difference (NDD) optimization, a lightweight positive diagonal curvature-aware training strategy, as a novel optimizer for fingerprint-based neural virtual screening against avian influenza A/H9N2, with the objective of evaluating its performance across aligned molecular fingerprint representations and chemically structured validation protocols. An aligned benchmark of 1,459 molecules consisting of 615 candidate active compounds and 844 decoys was represented by EState (79 features), PubChem (881 features), and Klekota–Roth (4,860 features) fingerprints, sharing identical molecule identities, labels, and split assignments. A fixed multilayer perceptron (MLP) classifier was trained with NDD and seven baseline optimizers under stratified, scaffold-key, and similarity-cluster split protocols across five repeated seeds. NDD achieved the highest descriptive ROC-AUC (Receiver Operating Characteriztic – Area Under the Curve) and PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under the Curve) on Klekota–Roth fingerprints under scaffold-key and similarity-cluster protocols, and remained competitive under the stratified split with ROC-AUC of 0.9872. Architecture-sensitivity tests confirmed stable NDD performance across multiple network configurations, with ROC-AUC values ranging from 0.9876 to 0.9890. Compared with Hessian-free optimization, NDD reduced per-run runtime from approximately 50–54 seconds to approximately 8 seconds on Klekota–Roth under the same CPU-only configuration while achieving comparable ranking performance. The novelty of this work lies in the first systematic assessment of NDD for H9N2 neural virtual screening, demonstrating that positive diagonal curvature-aware scaling provides a practical, stable, and computationally efficient optimization alternative in sparse high-dimensional ligand-based screening settings, although external validation and prospective experimental confirmation remain necessary before practical antiviral prioritization.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 禽流感 A/H9N2 造成持续的人畜共患病和兽医威胁,但用于 抗病毒药物 化合物优先级排序的有效计算工具仍然不发达,特别是在高维神经筛选中的​​优化器行为方面。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究提出了牛顿除差(NDD)优化,这是一种轻量级正对角曲率感知训练策略,作为针对 禽流感 A/H9N2 的基于指纹的神经虚拟筛选的新型优化器,目的是评估其在对齐的分子指纹表示和化学结构验证协议中的性能。
elements_zh.methods: 由 615 种候选活性化合物和 844 种诱饵组成的 1,459 个分子的对齐基准由 EState(79 个特征)、PubChem(881 个特征)和 Klekota–Roth(4,860 个特征)指纹代表,共享相同的分子身份、标签和分割分配。

papers.title_zh: 针对 禽流感 A/H9N2 基于指纹的神经虚拟筛选的牛顿差分优化
papers.source_body_en: Avian influenza A/H9N2 poses persistent zoonotic and veterinary threats, yet efficient computational tools for antiviral compound prioritization remain underdeveloped, particularly with respect to optimizer behavior in high-dimensional neural screening. This study proposes Newton Divided Difference (NDD) optimization, a lightweight positive diagonal curvature-aware training strategy, as a novel optimizer for fingerprint-based neural virtual screening against avian influenza A/H9N2, with the objective of evaluating its performance across aligned molecular fingerprint representations and chemically structured validation protocols. An aligned benchmark of 1,459 molecules consisting of 615 candidate active compounds and 844 decoys was represented by EState (79 features), PubChem (881 features), and Klekota–Roth (4,860 features) fingerprints, sharing identical molecule identities, labels, and split assignments. A fixed multilayer perceptron (MLP) classifier was trained with NDD and seven baseline optimizers under stratified, scaffold-key, and similarity-cluster split protocols across five repeated seeds. NDD achieved the highest descriptive ROC-AUC (Receiver Operating Characteriztic – Area Under the Curve) and PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under the Curve) on Klekota–Roth fingerprints under scaffold-key and similarity-cluster protocols, and remained competitive under the stratified split with ROC-AUC of 0.9872. Architecture-sensitivity tests confirmed stable NDD performance across multiple network configurations, with ROC-AUC values ranging from 0.9876 to 0.9890. Compared with Hessian-free optimization, NDD reduced per-run runtime from approximately 50–54 seconds to approximately 8 seconds on Klekota–Roth under the same CPU-only configuration while achieving comparable ranking performance. The novelty of this work lies in the first systematic assessment of NDD for H9N2 neural virtual screening, demonstrating that positive diagonal curvature-aware scaling provides a practical, stable, and computationally efficient optimization alternative in sparse high-dimensional ligand-based screening settings, although external validation and prospective experimental confirmation remain necessary before practical antiviral prioritization.
papers.abstract_zh: 禽流感 A/H9N2 造成持续的人畜共患病和兽医威胁,但用于 抗病毒药物 化合物优先级排序的有效计算工具仍然不发达,特别是在高维神经筛选中的​​优化器行为方面。本研究提出了牛顿除差(NDD)优化,这是一种轻量级正对角曲率感知训练策略,作为针对 禽流感 A/H9N2 的基于指纹的神经虚拟筛选的新型优化器,目的是评估其在对齐的分子指纹表示和化学结构验证协议中的性能。由 615 种候选活性化合物和 844 种诱饵组成的 1,459 个分子的对齐基准由 EState(79 个特征)、PubChem(881 个特征)和 Klekota–Roth(4,860 个特征)指纹代表,共享相同的分子身份、标签和分割分配。固定多层感知器 (MLP) 分类器使用 NDD 和七个基线优化器在分层、支架键和相似性聚类分割协议下跨五个重复种子进行训练。NDD 在支架密钥和相似性聚类协议下的 Klekota–Roth 指纹上实现了最高的描述性 ROC-AUC(接收者操作特征 - 曲线下面积)和 PR-AUC(曲线下精确召回面积),并且在分层分割下保持竞争力,ROC-AUC 为 0.9872。架构敏感性测试证实了跨多种网络配置的稳定 NDD 性能,ROC-AUC 值范围为 0.9876 至 0.9890。与无 Hessian 优化相比,在相同的仅 CPU 配置下,NDD 将 Klekota-Roth 上的每次运行时间从大约 50-54 秒减少到大约 8 秒,同时实现了相当的排名性能。这项工作的新颖性在于首次系统评估 H9N2 神经虚拟筛选的 NDD,证明正对角线曲率感知缩放在稀疏高维配体筛选设置中提供了实用、稳定且计算高效的优化替代方案,尽管在实际 抗病毒药物 优先级排序之前仍然需要外部验证和前瞻性实验确认。

papers.title: Antibody profiles across H5N1 and previously circulating viruses are highly dynamic and age- and imprint- independent
papers.abstract: Abstract The increasing incidence of H5N1 influenza virus transmission from animal species to humans has heightened concerns about an imminent H5N1 pandemic. Prior studies using recombinant hemagglutinin and neuraminidase proteins have reported age-dependent cross-reactivity to H5N1, attributed to immune imprinting from an individual’s first influenza virus exposure. However, whether this pattern holds when using whole inactivated virus (WIV), capturing antibodies against diverse viral proteins, and is stable over time remains unknown. We therefore aimed to determine whether H5N1 cross-reactivity of pre-existing antibodies to whole virus follows an age-dependent or imprinting-specific pattern, and whether this pattern is stable over a five-year period. To this end, we measured serum antibody levels in adolescents, adults and seniors by ELISA using whole inactivated H5N1 virus as antigen rather than purified proteins. Detectable, albeit generally low, levels of H5N1-reactive antibodies were present in most individuals, irrespective of age. Comparison of antibody levels against H5N1 with those to five historical influenza virus strains revealed a consistent positive correlation between H5N1-reactive antibodies and responses to the H1N1pdm09 strain A/California/7/2009 (CA), across all age groups. Using unbiased clustering of antibody titers against H5N1, CA, and the H3N2 strain A/Perth/16/2009 (PE), we identified seven distinct age-transcending antibody profiles. These profiles covered individuals with varying titers to all three included viruses but also identified individuals with high anti-CA levels, yet low anti-H5N1 levels and vice versa. Moreover, despite stable antibody levels over a five-year interval in the study population, individual antibody levels and profiles fluctuated considerably over this period. Taken together, our results confirm the presence of H5N1-reactive antibodies in human sera and their association with previously circulating strains. However, they also caution against inferring antibody levels against a new strain based solely on responses to antigenically related strains and highlight the limitations of extrapolating immune status from single timepoint measurements.
